qasam hai aasman ki , aur raat ko aaney walay ki
. aur tumhen kiya maloom kay woh raat ko aaney wala kiya hai-?
kay koi jaan aesi nahi hai jiss ki koi nigrani kernay wala mojood naa ho .
abb insan ko yeh dekhna chahiye kay ussay kiss cheez say peda kiya gaya hai ?
ussay aik uchaltey huye paani say peda kiya gaya hai
jo peeth aur seenay ki haddiyon kay darmiyan say nikalta hai .
beyshak woh ussay dobara peda kernay per poori tarah qadir hai .
jiss din tamam posheeda baaton ki janch hogi ,
tu insan kay paas naa apna koi zor hoga , naa koi madadgaar .
qasam hai barish bharay aasman ki ,
aur phoot parrney wali zameen ki
kay yeh ( Quran ) aik faisla kunn baat hai ,
aur yeh koi mazaq nahi hai .
beyshak yeh ( kafir log ) chaalen chal rahey hain ,
aur mein bhi apni chaal chal raha hun .
lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum inn kafiron ko dheel do , enhen thoray dino apney haal per chorr do .
